pullRequests.title: Launcher redesign around a list of the games, a faster launcher, and Size Matters
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: claude/eager-galileo-7v9jmz
pullRequests.body:
What this does
The launcher is reworked so a player sees one game at a time, simply, and a developer's tools stay out of the way until switched on. Every game gets the same weight. The rework follows OpenGOAL's launcher: it opens straight onto the game you last played, with all the games in a list on the left, all the same size. Size Matters (rac5) joins as the fifth game, and the launcher does less work while idle or when its window regains focus.
The commits are grouped so each can be…

commits.headline: fix(port): hostgen keeps a game vfprintf apart from the library's
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
The US decompilation defines vfprintf(FILE *, const char *, void *) under
the label FUN_00116da8. Clang took it for the C library's vfprintf, gave the
definition the host's va_list while the body used the game pointer, and the
translation cast one to the other; on Linux on ARM64 va_list is a struct and
the launcher's 0.7.1 build stopped there. prep now renames such a labelled
function NAME_game in its file (vfprintf, vprintf, vsprintf, vsnprintf and
the scanf ones); the label keeps the…

commits.headline: docs(rac1/pal): func_L01_002635C8 checked against VU0 program 28259
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
The functional C for Novalis's ripple setup said "medium" because its two
vcallms (0xC80, 0xC90) were taken on trust as FastCos and FastSin. Decoded
the microprogram from the executable's copy of program 28259 (micro memory
0xC80..0xD18): 0xC80 adds pi/2 and falls into 0xC90, the folded 9th-order
sine, so the calls are exactly func_001F9F90 and func_001F9FA8. The program
writes only vf1..vf6, ACC and I, so the registers the routine keeps across
the calls (vf10, vf12, vf13, vf15, vf16, vf20)…

commits.author: Veradictus

because Git checks them out with CRLF there (endOfLine: auto), the
extractor plan's test expected a path joined with slashes, and clippy
found two imports that only the Unix-only tests use. A launcher-windows
job runs the same checks as the Linux one so it stays that way.

commits.headline: fix(port/rac1-ntsc): fast_arc_sin reads its constants at 0x1606A0 again
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
The US pass (5a956077) moved the table to 0x160760, reading the gp
offset as -0x64A0; the instruction at 0x1F9E2C is addiu gp-0x6560, which
is 0x1606A0 (gp 0x166C00), where 1.5707, -0.2121, 0.0743 and -0.0187 are.
0x160760 holds unrelated words, so every arcsin was wrong and the follow
camera pitched straight up or down on every planet. Rilgar's camera now
follows PAL's frame for frame in the same scripted run.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.headline: perf(platform): detect discrete GPU on Linux multi-GPU systems
commits.author: Lynder063
commits.body:
On multi-GPU Linux systems (such as a desktop with an AMD Ryzen CPU with
integrated graphics and an AMD Radeon PCIe dedicated card), Mesa's
DRI_PRIME=1 switches to the non-default secondary GPU. If the system
booted with the discrete card as primary (boot_vga=1), blindly setting
DRI_PRIME=1 demoted rendering to the slow integrated CPU graphics.

Query /sys/class/drm/ sysfs cards to inspect boot_vga and dedicated VRAM
to keep the primary GPU if already discrete, or target the discrete card's
PCI…

commits.headline: perf(renderer): use sampler objects in DirectRenderer
commits.author: Lynder063
commits.body:
DirectRenderer previously called glTexParameteri four times on every single
draw to set min/mag filters and wrap modes. As noted in docs/port/SETTINGS.md,
a sampler object per state removes redundant driver state changes during 2D
draw call submission.

Declare glGenSamplers, glDeleteSamplers, glBindSampler, and glSamplerParameteri
in gl.h and pre-create 16 sampler objects in DirectRenderer for each filter
and wrap permutation, binding only when the sampler index changes.

Co-Authored-By:…

commits.headline: fix(port): install Linux desktop entry and icons for KDE Wayland taskbar
commits.author: Lynder063
commits.body:
Under Wayland compositors (such as KDE Plasma's Icons-Only Task
Manager), client-side window icons via SDL_SetWindowIcon are not
supported by xdg-shell. Instead, the taskbar resolves icons by
matching the window's Wayland app_id against .desktop files in
~/.local/share/applications/ and icon themes in ~/.local/share/icons/hicolor/.

Explicitly set SDL_HINT_APP_ID and SDL_HINT_APP_NAME in set_app_metadata,
and install the game's embedded 512x512 icon and .desktop files on Linux
upon startup from…

commits.headline: fix(launcher): set XCURSOR_THEME fallback on Wayland to prevent GTK cursor assertion crash
commits.author: Lynder063
commits.body:
On Wayland (specifically GNOME on Fedora/RHEL and certain stripped or
misconfigured desktop environments), GTK 3's Wayland backend aborts
on startup with:

    _gdk_wayland_display_get_scaled_cursor_theme: assertion failed: (display_wayland->cursor_theme_name)

when GSettings cannot resolve a cursor theme name or when GSettings
schemas within an AppImage are missing or unreadable.

Export XCURSOR_THEME=default and XCURSOR_SIZE=24 prior to GTK/Tauri
initialization if unset, ensuring…
